SIMPLE FROM START TO FINISH

How does it work?

From choosing your dishes to a freezer full of homemade meals.

01

Choose 5 recipes

Select five dishes from the menu and create a mix that suits your household.

02

Receive your shopping list

I’ll send you one clear shopping list with everything you need.

03

Buy the ingredients from your preferred supermarket or local food shop.

04

MEET MEGHAN

Following my heart, back to the kitchen.

My love for cooking started as a little girl, standing beside my grandmother in the kitchen. One of my earliest Christmas memories is a little toy oven that actually got warm. Years later, while studying, I earned money cooking for a well-known catering company in the Netherlands.

Life took me into the world of tech, where I spent over 10 years building successful businesses. But becoming a mother changed my perspective. I asked myself: How can I teach my daughters to follow their hearts if I’m not following mine? And so, I found my way back to the kitchen.

I’m half Dutch, half Indonesian, and Makan means “to eat” in Indonesian. With Makan by Meghan, I bring my love for food and my heritage into the homes of expat families, making everyday meals easier with nourishing, homemade food and a taste of home.

GOOD FOOD FOR REAL LIFE

Who is Makan for?

Makan by Meghan is for families and people who love good food, but could use a little more ease in their everyday lives.

01 / FAMILY LIFE

Parents with full plates

School lunchboxes to pack, snacks to prepare, and the daily question of what’s for dinner. I make it easier to keep family meals nourishing, varied, and homemade without starting from scratch every day.

02 / A TASTE OF HOME

A little taste of home

Living away from home can mean missing the dishes and flavours you grew up with. I bring familiar favourites and comforting flavours into your own kitchen, including dishes that can be hard to find nearby.

03 / BUSY DAYS

Busy professionals

When work fills the day, meal prep can become one more task on the list. Keep your fridge or freezer stocked with satisfying, nourishing meals that are ready when you are.

04 / A NEW CHAPTER

The newborn season

Those first weeks with a new baby are precious, and often exhausting. Let me take care of meal prep while you settle in with your little one and find your rhythm as a family.

GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions

The essentials, before we get cooking.

How does it work?
  1. Choose your recipes.
  2. Choose a day for me to come to your home.
  3. I’ll send you the shopping list.
  4. Do the shopping using the list.
  5. I come and cook at your home.
  6. I clean your kitchen.

Your tuppers are ready to freeze and enjoy!

How many meals do I get?
20 filled tuppers, around 40 portions, depending on the recipes and portion sizes.
Can I choose my own recipes?
Yes. We choose five recipes together to suit your family.
Are Indonesian dishes included in the price?
Some Indonesian dishes cost extra because they use homemade spice pastes and imported ingredients that aren’t available locally. I’ll confirm any extra costs before we finalise your menu.
Who does the shopping?
You can shop from my list, or add grocery shopping as an optional extra.
Can I add breakfast or snacks?
Yes. Breakfast prep and snack prep are available as optional extras.
Do I need to provide tuppers?
Yes. We’ll agree on suitable containers before your session.
Can I freeze the meals?
Many dishes freeze well. Others are best kept in the fridge. I’ll advise you for your chosen recipes.
Can you cater for allergies?
Tell me about allergies and dietary needs before we plan your menu, so we can discuss what’s suitable.
Where do you offer the service?
Sitges and the Garraf area. Message me to check your location.
How much does it cost?
Weekly: €197 per session. Every two weeks: €247 per session. On-demand: €325 per session. Groceries and optional extras are charged separately.
How do I book?
Message me on WhatsApp and we’ll find a date that works for you. Book a session.
